name: TamGen
one_liner: Pocket-conditioned GPT chemical language model paired with docking/IC50 feedback loops to design tuberculosis ClpP protease inhibitors.

loop.proposes: A 3D-pocket-encoder + chemical-GPT decoder proposes SMILES structures conditioned on the target protein binding pocket and seed scaffolds.
loop.judged_by: RDKit synthetic accessibility, physics-based molecular docking, and wet-lab enzymatic IC50 and whole-cell M. tuberculosis assays evaluate candidates.
loop.steers: Top-scoring docked and assayed hits seed iterative scaffold refinement rounds.

headline_result: Designed novel Mycobacterium tuberculosis ClpP inhibitors validated in wet-lab assays with strong enzymatic inhibition (IC50 = 0.9 uM).
caveat: Requires a known 3D crystal structure of the target binding site to encode pocket geometry.
beyond_harness_note: Physics docking filters and wet-lab enzymatic IC50 assays judge and steer pocket-conditioned molecular generation.
generative_model: 3D geometric pocket encoder + chemical GPT decoder
algorithmic_authority: Molecular docking engine and wet-lab IC50 enzymatic assay

sources.title: Target-aware molecular generation with TamGen (Nature Communications, 2024)

verification.notes: Checked against Wu et al., Nature Communications 15, 2024.
